param: B The constant influx rate of the human hosts
k The progression rate from exposed to infectious for hosts (1/latent period)
μₕ The natural death rate of the human hosts
μᵥ The natural death rate of the mosquitoes
γ₁ The recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts
γ₂ The recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts
βᵥ The transmission rate from infectious hosts to susceptible mosquitoes
βₕ The transmission rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible hosts
ρ The probability of exposed hosts transferring to symptomatic infectious hosts
σ The factor characterizing the intensity of reinfection of asymptomatic infectious hosts and their relative infectivity
rho_k Rate of progression from Exposed to Symptomatic Infectious
one_minus_rho_k Rate of progression from Exposed to Asymptomatic Infectious
sigma_beta_h Contact rate for reinfection of asymptomatic hosts
sigma_beta_v Contact rate from asymptomatic hosts to susceptible mosquitoes
μᵥ_birth Birth rate of mosquitoes, assumed to balance the death rate to maintain a stable population
